sources: https://www.oswegokansas.com/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=27&Itemid=28 (City of Oswego 'RV Parks', plain HTTP, read 2026-11-06): 'Oswego has two RV Parks - Kamp Siesta (part of Riverside Park) and a 4 site area in Danny Elliott Park.'; 'Location Kamp Siesta: From US Highway 160 go North on Kansas Street to the Fairground buildings, then just West of the Fairground buildings and turn North.'; 'Kamp Siesta has 42 sites . Sites have 20, 30 and 50 amp electric service, water hook-ups and a dump station onsite. From April to November a bathhouse and shower is available, along with a covered concrete patio with picnic tables. The park is in a nicely shaded corner, just north of the ballfields and fairgrounds buildings. It is available for rent on a first come, first serve basis except during the fair when all sites are reserved for fair participants.'; 'For those who travel the country with horses, a horse barn is located on site.'; 'Price per site is $15 per night. You can mail payments ... come in and pay at the City Office at 703 5th St, or there is also a drop box on site'; 'Danny Elliott Park is located on the north bank of the Neosho River just below Riverside Park. Oswego RV Regulations, 'Updated 9-12-16' (https://www.oswegokansas.com/files/2016/RV_REGULATIONSRev_9-12-16(1).pdf, linked from the RV Parks page, read 2026-11-06): 'A dump station is available at Kamp Siesta, southeast of the bathrooms.'; 'For reservations call the Oswego City Office at 620-795-4433 Monday thru Friday, 8am to 5 pm.'; '$15.00 per day whether spots are reserved or on a first come first serve basis.'; 'Tents--$10.00'; 'Monthly Rate - $300.00 with prior approval and can stay up to 1 year except for Fair Week ... note: City of Oswego campground in Riverside Park, in a shaded corner just north of the ballfields and Labette County Fairgrounds buildings; the Neosho River is beyond the woods to the north. Bathhouse and showers April to November; covered patio with picnic tables; horse barn. Enter from North St west of the fairground buildings; don't drive a rig straight past the gates at the top of the hill. --Claude
summary: City page (2026-11-06) confirms everything stored: 42 sites, 20/30/50 A + water, dump, bathhouse/showers April-November, $15, FCFS, fair-week closure (July 18-25 2026). All groups re-sourced to the city page. Pin is ~240 m north of the campground near the river: move to ~37.1731,-95.1046. Not waterfront confirmed. Add lead: Danny Elliott Park (4 sites, city, on the Neosho).
flags: PIN (apply.py doesn't write it): stored 37.17498,-95.10470 is at the buildings on the road down to the river, ~240 m north of the campground. The sites (rows of angled back-in pads west of a loop road, plus a looped area to the east) are just north of the ballfields, centre ~37.1731,-95.1046; Google's 37.17280,-95.10444 is on the west row. Propose 37.1731,-95.1046.
WATERFRONT 'not waterfront' confirmed: from the campground the Neosho River is ~200+ m north behind a band of woods; the ballfields and fairgrounds are to the south.

ADD LEAD: Danny Elliott Park, Oswego (City of Oswego), on the north bank of the Neosho River 'just below Riverside Park' - 'Four camping sites with electric and water hook-up and concrete pads', same $15 rate and drop box, dump at Kamp Siesta, closed for fair week, phone 620-795-4433, page https://www.oswegokansas.com/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=27&Itemid=28. Google 'Danny Elliott Park' 4.4/23 at 37.17667,-95.10319: a gravel lot at the river's edge with a fishing pier, ~10-25 m from the water on open ground (LAKEFRONT-type riverfront candidate). I couldn't pick out the four concrete pads on imagery; needs its own vetting (site sizes, whether the pads are at the lot).

LONG-STAY (judgment call, not a drop): the 2016 RV Regulations offer 'Monthly Rate - $300.00 with prior approval and can stay up to 1 year' and a monthly construction-crew rate. The current page sells nights first ('Price per site is $15 per night', drop box on site) and pitches family reunions, camping clubs, ball tournaments; no seasonal-only sites or residents seen. Kept as an ordinary overnight city campground.

BOOKING: kept FCFS (current page). The 2016 regulations say 'For reservations call the Oswego City Office at 620-795-4433' and '$15.00 per day whether spots are reserved or on a first come first serve basis' - phone reservations may still be possible, but the current page says first come, first serve, so not written.
PHONE 620-795-4433 (City Office) and WEBSITE (city RV Parks page) confirmed.
SEASON not written: only the bathhouse is dated (April-November); the page doesn't say whether the electric/water sites stay open in winter.
SAND: none - gravel/grass back-in pads under trees.
